content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 denies the claim for missing required prior authorization; the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. The codes and billing order are valid, so resubmission would not address the denial, and the remaining deductible does not establish patient liability for this authorization denial. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available and can seek reconsideration using the existing documentation, although its low quality may limit success.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
